description: EVM vectors written by drongo EvmVectorGeneratorTest for the phone's read-only LitVM port. Do not edit by hand.
built: An input given as "<key>Parts" instead of "<key>" is the concatenation of its parts: a string is itself; {"repeat": s, "times": n} is s repeated n times; {"base64": [parts]} is the standard padded base64 of the UTF-8 bytes of its parts. "<key>Length" is the built text's length in UTF-16 units and "<key>Sha256" the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes. ABI results are hex text. A long decoded value is given as valueLength (UTF-16 units) and valueSha256 (of its UTF-8 bytes). A json case's "canonical" is the parsed value written compactly: objects in the reader's key order, numbers as BigDecimal.toPlainString, strings with \" \\ \n \t \r and \uXXXX (lower-case hex) for every other UTF-16 unit outside U+0020..U+007E.

clean.rule: One rule for all contract and metadata text (TextRules): the fixed table below is stripped, as are lone surrogates; tab, line feed, carriage return and space separate words. singleLine: a run of separators between kept characters is one space, none at the ends. description: a run holding a line feed or carriage return is one line feed, at most 20 lines (later runs are a space). Caps count code points after cleaning and never leave a separator at the end. svg: SvgSubset's text, which collapses every separator to a space and refuses more than 200 code points.
